sloka: तारयस्व च मां गङ्गां दर्शयस्व च तापसान् ।ततो मुनिभ्यो दास्यामि वांसास्याभरणानि च ।। ७.४६.२९ ॥
transliteration: tārayasva ca māṁ gaṅgāṁ darśayasva ca tāpasān ।tato munibhyo dāsyāmi vāṁsāsyābharaṇāni ca ।। 7.46.29 ॥

translations.english: Please ferry me across the Ganga and show me the ascetics, and then I will give clothes and ornaments to the sages.
